messages:
Maya: Heads up — found a docs bug in the embeddings API page. The curl example shows sending an array directly, but our API expects {"input": [ ... ] } for batch calls. This is causing confusion in the quickstart snippet.

Dan: Ugh, thanks for catching. Which file/PR?

Maya: The example in docs/embeddings.md in PR #4927. The curl example currently:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '["foo", "bar"]'
```
It should be:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"input": ["foo", "bar"]}'
```

Priya: Also the JS snippet for batch embeddings uses `input: "single string"` in one place and `["a","b"]` in another. We should standardize to always show the object shape for batch and single-call examples separately.

Alex: Good catch. There's also an automated linter that flags mismatched example shapes; docs-bot just posted a failure for the PR this morning.

docs-bot: PR #4927 — examples-lint — failed: example_request_shape mismatch on docs/embeddings.md. See CI logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/4927/logs

Dan: Plan: Maya/ Priya — can one of you update the curl and JS examples to be explicit about single vs batch? I'll add a tiny migration note for existing customers who copy/pasted the array form.

Maya: I can do the curl and add a short note: "Note: For batch requests, wrap inputs in { \"input\": [...] }. Single-string requests may still accept \"input\": \"single\" or { \"input\": [\"single\"] } depending on SDK; prefer object for clarity."

Priya: I'll fix the JS snippet and the generated SDK examples. Proposed JS examples:
```js
// single input
const res = await client.embeddings.create({ input: "hello world" });
// batch inputs
const res = await client.embeddings.create({ input: ["a","b","c"] });
```
Also update the curl examples to mirror those shapes.

Alex: For the SDK codegen, remember to update the openapi example payloads so the generated snippets show the object form. Otherwise CI will keep failing.

Maya: I pushed a tiny branch with the curl fix and a one-line migration note. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4931 — it should fix the linter for that example.

Priya: Nice. I'll open a follow-up PR to standardize all embeddings snippets across languages and update the changelog entry: "docs(embeddings): clarify batch vs single examples".

Dan: Thanks. After both PRs land, I'll re-run the doc build and confirm the examples in the hosted API reference preview. If anything else pops up we'll iterate. :thumbsup:

Maya: Verified locally with the docs preview server; example now renders correctly and the curl form returns a 200 when I hit the staging API.

docs-bot: PR #4931 merged by Maya. CI green.

Alex: Great. Can we also add a short test in the examples-lint harness to catch object-vs-array mistakes for embeddings specifically? Small unit test that parses examples and validates the request JSON shape.

Priya: Yep, I'll add it in the next PR — should be a tiny one-liner.

Dan: Awesome work. Closing thread once the examples-lint test is in.

Maya: Marking as resolved on the docs tracker. :white_check_mark:
